jobs.description:
Design products for athletes around the world that translate the data from Trackman’s best-in-class radar technology into actionable insights that help our users build a better game.

You’ll be joining our team of ~20 product designers from Canada, Mexico, Australia, England, Latvia, New Zealand, Slovakia, Ireland, and Denmark who have fun and challenge each other every day in delivering exceptional design work.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our team. You'll work closely with designers, developers, and product owners on experiences, owning specific areas of the user journey over time. You will:

• 
Turn complex performance data into interfaces that are simply enjoyable to use, from social sessions with friends to immersive training and entertainment setups.

• 
Conduct user research, validate ideas, and deliver pixel-perfect designs.

• 
Collaborate closely with your developers and product owner in a dedicated product team.

Figma recently featured our team in a customer story on how we built a design-first culture at Trackman. Worth a read before you apply:

How Trackman built a design-first culture and a competitive edge

Job requirements

• 
4+ years of product design experience on a dedicated product team (university projects don't count).

• 
Strong visual communication and UI design skills. You can turn complex information into clear, intuitive interfaces, and work confidently within design systems.

• 
Clear, confident communication. You can explain your decision-making and are flexible when provided with feedback.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities.

• 
A portfolio that shows real problems, real constraints, and real outcomes.

Bonus points for

• 
Interest in sports, performance or entertainment products.

• 
Experience running or contributing to user research, and turning insights into design decisions.

• 
Experience with data-heavy products or visualizing performance data.

What you get

• 
A design team that genuinely love working together and helping each other grow through regular critiques, feedback sessions, and plenty of informal sparring.

• 
Access to our onsite fitness center, all-you-can-play golf simulator, a great lunch and much more!

• 
Social happenings and company events throughout the year.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to play a central role in architecting and evolving the software systems behind Trackman Range and Golf Broadcast.

You will work at the intersection of software engineering and applied algorithms, translating mathematical models and signal-processing concepts into robust, production-grade systems.

You will be responsible for system-level design decisions, improving software architecture, and driving engineering quality across the codebase. This includes diagnosing complex system behavior, addressing performance regressions, and ensuring high standards of reliability, testability, and maintainability.

• 
Strong understanding of performance engineering, multi-threading, and system-level debugging (e.g., concurrency issues, performance regressions)

• 
Experience driving code quality, testing, CI/CD, and managing technical debt in production systems

• 
Experience with Linux-based systems for development, deployment, and debugging of distributed applications

• 
Experience with Docker for containerization and orchestration of those applications

• 
5+ years of relevant experience with ownership of critical systems or components

Other Valued Experience

• 
Radar technology, signal processing, numerical algorithms and sensor fusion

• 
Computer vision, tracking, and camera calibration

• 
Deep learning model implementation and optimization

• 
Real-time camera and video systems, including stream handling, data capture and encoding/decoding

• 
GPU acceleration and performance profiling

Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• 
Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• 
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• 
Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.

• 
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. ETL and Database technologies.

• 
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• 
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

Concept & Prototype Development

• 
You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• 
You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• 
You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• 
You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

Simulation & Validation

• 
You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• 
You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

Driver Specification & Verification

• 
You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• 
You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• 
You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• 
You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• 
You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

Job requirements

In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

• 
You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• 
You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• 
You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• 
You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• 
Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• 
Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• 
You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• 
You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• 
You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

Do you get a small, slightly nerdy kick out of working out why a conversion stopped firing three weeks ago and nobody noticed?

At Helion B2B we don't just "run ads" for our clients. We build data-driven growth engines for some of the most ambitious B2B companies in Europe. But an engine is only as good as its sensors. That's where you come in.

You won't just keep the engine running. You'll help build it.

You'll join our tracking team in Aarhus, working day to day with our Tracking Lead. Real ownership early, someone who has done all of it sitting right next to you, and a direct hand in how the practice develops. We have standards, and we like them being challenged. If you think we're doing something the hard way, we'd rather hear it in week two than in year two.

You'll work across all of it: new implementations, server-side setups, multi-market containers, consent, QA, troubleshooting, and the measurement plans that hold it together. Real clients, and real responsibility for whether their measurement holds up.

Some of that is building something new. A lot of it is taking a setup that already exists and making it better than you found it, which is where data quality actually comes from. Your scope over the clients you look after grows from there.

The job doesn't stop when the data arrives. Part of the work is reporting and analysis: helping a client see what their numbers are telling them, and noticing when a number is telling them something wrong. Mostly technical work, then, but not only

Your playground

• 
Google Tag Manager: Web containers from day one, server-side (sGTM) as you grow into it.

• 
GA4: Event design, debugging, and making sure the numbers actually mean something.

• 
HubSpot: we're an Elite HubSpot partner, so tracking data and CRM data have to meet properly.

• 
Consent management: Cookiebot and Cookie Information, Consent Mode, and the GDPR reality behind them.

• 
Data Studio and reporting: Turning all of the above into something a client can read and act on, and being able to say what it means.

• 
AI-assisted tracking: We're actively building agent-supported auditing, monitoring and insight workflows. You'll use them, break them, and help shape where they go next.

What you need on day one

• 
You can build and debug tags, triggers and variables in a web GTM container on your own. Preview mode and Tag Assistant are familiar territory.

• 
You can configure and debug GA4, and you know what to start checking when a dimension comes back as (not set).

• 
You're a finisher. "Done" means tested and verified, not deployed.

• 
You think for yourself. When you hit a wall, you research, test and come back with a proposal rather than waiting for instructions.

• 
You're curious about where AI is taking this field. You don't need experience with it. You need to want to poke at it.

Somewhere around three to five years of hands-on tracking experience, from an agency or in-house, is the usual shape. It's a guide, not a gate.

What you'll learn here

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

Learn more about DUOS at www.duos.dk.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Electronics Engineer for Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an engineering role where you help turn advanced sports technology into scalable, high-quality products? At Trackman, you will play a key role in industrializing, testing, and producing innovative hardware solutions bridging R&D and production with real technical influence and cross-functional impact.

Your Role

As an experienced Engineer in “Manufacturing Engineering” which is a part of the “Hardware Development & Supply” organization, you will act as a key technical contributor across R&D and Production. Your responsibilities will be to ensure that Trackman’s new and existing hardware platforms can be produced reliably, at scale and volume.

You will be expected to ensure design for manufacturing (DFM).  This involves challenge designs, propose improvements, and drive best practices across the organization in close collaboration with R&D hardware, tracking and software teams, in-house production, EMS suppliers, supply chain, and management.

This role suits an experienced engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical expertise and ownership.

What you will be doing

• Specifying, developing, and driving a strategy for production- and test engineering equipment to support new and existing hardware platforms. We work with GHZ Radars, Computer Modules, Camera Sensors and other state of the art electronics.

• Act as an experienced technical interface between R&D and Production, ensuring manufacturability and testability are built in from early design phases.

• Design, build and validate production- and test solutions for all relevant technologies. This includes fixtures for assemblies, automation, “bed of nails” setups, and other supporting electronics.

• Develop automated test solutions using NI TestStand, Python, and C#, including data handling, traceability, and statistical analysis.

• Perform hands-on debugging utilizing signal generators, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes ect. for root-cause analysis.

• Participate in schematic entry, reviews, placement and carry out layout and routing of simple PCBs used in test fixtures and support electronics

• Drive collaboration with EMS suppliers, including transfer, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of test and production processes

• Analyze production and test data to improve yield, quality, and robustness, and to support data-driven decision-making

• Strengthen the ability to plan and execute according to plan, i.e. spending part of your time doing project coordination work supporting the whole team.

Job requirements

What You Bring

We imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Electronics Engineering and have extensive experience (5+ years) within electronics development, production, or test engineering

• Have strong practical experience with test development, electronics debugging, and production environments

• Advanced user of relevant lab test equipment (e.g., oscilloscope, signal generators, spectrum analyzers etc.)

• Are comfortable taking technical ownership and influencing decisions across teams and senior stakeholders

• Work in a structured, proactive way and naturally drive improvements

• Fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken and located in Denmark

Technical skills:

• Advanced experience with Python, NI TestStand, C# and data analysis.

• Experience with RF measurements in the GHz range and understanding of schematics.

• Experience in implementing test equipment at EMS suppliers, transferring test data between different sites

• Knowledge of camera and optics calibration principles.

The Office  We are located in our state-of-art HQ in Hørsholm, located at DTU Science Park. We take great pride in the building we designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness centre, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology  Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Please submit your resume and cover letter, outlining your relevant skills and interest in the position, to jfj@ermh.dk.  Phone no. +45 92825225 for questions about the position. We call for interviews on a continuous basis and will close the application process when the right person for the job has been found. So better apply today than tomorrow.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The workload will typically be 10-16 hours per week, and we offer flexibility around your exam periods. In our company we value an open dialogue, respect and trust and we are always aiming high in our work, we trust you will do the same if you join us!

jobs.occupation: Evening Operations Inspector. Join Our Night Team in Køge!
jobs.description:
Evening Operations Inspector!

Do you thrive when the rest of the city winds down? Are you sharp on cleaning standards, customer service, and team leadership – and ready to keep operations running smoothly when the sun goes down?

We are a leading Danish facility service partner headquartered in Køge, supported by a team of 100 dedicated employees. We serve businesses across Zealand, Lolland and Falster with high-quality cleaning and maintenance solutions. Our goal is to set the standard within facility services and create a healthy, sustainable work environment for all our clients. With us, you’ll join a workplace that prioritises innovation, employee care and long-term sustainability.

About the job:

In this role, you will be responsible for onboarding new customers in the afternoon and evening, performing quality inspections on-site, and ensuring that our service always meets UFPA’s high standards. You will coach and motivate our evening staff, handle last-minute operational changes such as sickness or holiday cover, and manage schedules and documentation in Office 365. You will also support our headquarters in Køge when needed.

Your Evening Mission:

• Onboarding new customers during afternoon and evening hours.

• Quality inspections at customer locations – ensuring our high standards are met.

• Coaching and motivating evening staff to deliver their very best.

• Handling last-minute changes such as sickness or holiday cover.

• Coordinating schedules and reports using Office 365.

• Supporting HQ operations in Køge when needed.

We are looking for someone who…

• An outgoing, hands-on leader who inspires and guides the evening crew.

• Experienced in the cleaning industry (a big plus).

• Organised, solution-focused, and calm under pressure.

• Fluent in English – Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

• Digitally skilled (Office 365).

• Holds a valid Category B driving licence.

• Fully flexible and happy to work primarily in the evening.

What We Offer:

• 
A dynamic full-time position in a company focused on development and a healthy work environment.

• 
Freedom with responsibility and the opportunity to further specialise in facade cleaning and window polishing.

• 
A company vehicle (commercial plates) along with all necessary equipment and workwear.

• 
A competitive salary, with the option to negotiate a pension scheme, and opportunities for personal development.

• 
Start date: as soon as possible.

Ready to apply?

Send your CV, motivated application, and – if you dare – a short video presentation to  Victoria at vlu@ufpa.dk or if questions call 61 74 66 56

Bring your energy to the night shift – and help us keep our customers shining long after sunset!

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare/överläkare inom kardiologi till Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Om du är på jakt för nya utmaningar på jobbet och funderar på att jobba i Danmark är kardiologen på Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse ett självklart val.

Här kan du vara med och påverka framtidens hjärtmedicin och samtidigt få möjlighet att utveckla och leda ditt eget specialområde.

På hjärtmedicinska avdelningen (Medicin 2) kommer du som specialistläkare att spela en central roll för den kliniska verksamheten och yrkesområdets utveckling. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med avdelningens övriga specialistläkare, chefer och andra professioner för att skapa smidiga och sammanhängande patientförlopp.

Yrkesmässiga utmaningar och ett flexibelt arbetsliv

Som specialistläkare hos oss får du inte bara en tjänst. Du får möjlighet att styra inriktningen inom ett eller flera specialområden, om du har ambitionen och intresset för det.

Du får

• möjlighet att ta ansvar för och utveckla ett helt eget specialområde inom exempelvis ischemi, arytmi, hjärtklaffssjukdomar eller bilddiagnostik i form av ekokardiografi, hjärt-CT och hjärt-MR

• möjlighet att delta i forskningen vid avdelningen

• möjlighet att ingå i en högspecialiserad miljö med engagerade kollegor

• ett nära samarbete med övriga professioner och en hög grad av kollegialt utbyte.

Dessutom kan vi anpassa tjänsten så att den passar dina behov. På Medicin 2 lägger vi stor vikt vid att skapa balans mellan arbete och fritid, och vi prioriterar stort inflytande och ansvar.

Om dig

Vi tror att du

• är specialistläkare i kardiologi, eller är på väg att bli det

• fokuserar på att utveckla vårdkvaliteten och förbättra patientförloppet

• trivs i en miljö där man både för ett nära samarbete och arbetar självständigt

• bidrar till en aktiv och god arbetsmiljö

• har ett intresse för kvalitet, utbildning och eventuellt forskning

• kommunicerar öppet och konstruktivt.

Om oss

Vår avdelning bedriver verksamhet i två olika lokaler i Næstved respektive Slagelse, som ligger 30 km från varandra.

I Slagelse består avdelningen av två vårdavdelningar med 24 respektive 20 sängplatser. Därutöver har vi en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning.

I Næstved består avdelningen av ett trombos- och koagulationscentrum, en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning. Utöver detta rymmer lokalerna även ett diagnostiskt centrum.

Vi är för närvarande 12 specialistläkare inom kardiologi samt specialistläkare inom avdelningens övriga specialistfunktioner.

Vi ansvarar för undervisningen av medicinstudenter från Köpenhamns universitet.

Därför ska du välja Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital fokuserar vi på yrkeskompetens, samarbete mellan professioner, kvalitet, utbildning och forskning.

Specialister spelar en central roll både för den kliniska verksamheten och för den ämnesspecifika utvecklingen, och du blir en del av en miljö med hög grad av specialisering, tydliga ambitioner och goda möjligheter att påverka utvecklingen inom ditt specialistområde.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där fokus ligger på vårdkvalitet, kontinuitet i patientförloppet och förutsättningar som främjar såväl kliniskt arbete som utbildning och forskning.

Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats kommer att vara i Slagelse som har goda transportförbindelser med bland annat Odense, Köpenhamn och övriga Själland.

Är du redo för nästa steg?

Vill du vara med och utveckla kardiologin på Midt- og Vestsjælland? Då ser vi gärna att du hör av dig.

Mer information

Om du vill ha mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta tillförordnad chefsläkare Roman Sykulski på tel. +45 56 51 41 34 eller chefsjuksköterska Camilla Vest på tel. +45 93 56 84 89.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Du kommer att ingå i ett jourteam med bakjoursansvar från ditt eget hem i egenskap av överläkare och ha jour utanför arbetsplatsen i egenskap av specialistläkare.

Vi har omfattande erfarenhet av att hitta flexibla lösningar som möjliggör ett hållbart arbetsliv, så kontakta oss gärna för ett förutsättningslöst samtal om vilka möjligheter som finns.

Den professionella bedömningen av sökanden kommer att baseras på sökandens uppgifter om sina egna kompetenser i förhållande till de sju läkartjänsterna. Om du söker en tjänst som överläkare kommer en professionell bedömning att genomföras som kommer att vara avgörande för din kvalifikation som överläkare.

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks, och är villkorad med att det finns en tillfredsställande børneattest (utdrag ur belastningsregistret som visar om en person dömts för sexualbrott mot barn under 15 år).

Vi önskar tillsätta tjänsten senast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.
